opening.text: I'm here because I've been feeling really unwell lately. I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful, and I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. I have a fever, and since this started I've noticed unusual bleeding or bruising. Also, in the last 4 weeks I travelled to West Africa.
